title: The Feast of the Singing Aqueduct
description: At the late-summer feast, the aqueduct spills water through a row of clay flutes. Across the ravine, everyone raises a cup as the first notes carry.
alt: Water pours into blue and ochre ceramic flutes along an aqueduct, throwing rings of spray as people raise cups on a cliff across the ravine.
pairing: Late-summer feast × an aqueduct that plays clay flutes
